scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,green "pnpm --filter @agile/api run dev" "pnpm --filter @agile/web run dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agile/api run build && pnpm --filter @agile/web run build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter @agile/api run lint && pnpm --filter @agile/web run lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @agile/api run typecheck && pnpm --filter @agile/web run typecheck
